summary: AmperCap Acquisition Company filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 12,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit on June 4, 2026, generating $125 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one ordinary share and one right to receive one-tenth of a share upon a future business combination. Simultaneously, the sponsor and others purchased 512,500 private placement units at $10.00 each, raising $5.125 million. On June 10, the underwriters partially exercised their over-allotment option for 1,837,500 additional units, bringing total trust proceeds to approximately $144.8 million. The sponsor is AmperSPAC LLC. The blank-check company must complete an initial business combination within a specified period or liquidate. Watch for target announcement and shareholder redemption risks.
